entities.summary: The Church of Saint Panteleimon of Acharnai is a Greek Orthodox basilica located in central Athens, Greece. Measuring 63 meters in length and 48 meters in width, it is the largest church in the country. The church is situated in the heart of the modern Athens, near the busy Acharnon Avenue, which is one of the city's major thoroughfares, connecting central Athens to its northern suburbs.
